propositions: Extract the exception-handling spine (lines 555–629) from run() into a new interpret_failure() function in structured_run.py, preserving the three-arm ordering: UsageLimitExceeded, LLMError, broad Exception.
Arm order is critical: a broad-first spine would reclassify typed failures as provider outages; sampling-parameter rejections must be translated before the broad fallback.
Classify disposition as metadata without changing the raised exception type; tests must assert type(err) is X, not isinstance, because LLMConfigError subclasses LLMUnavailableError.
Retarget descriptive labels in test_llm_failure_matrix.py from stale line numbers (346, 365) to real anchors in structured_run.py (lines 84, 95, 131) to prevent future rot.
Runner.py must drop below 700 LOC on this commit (target: 782 → 699) and an end-to-end test must verify run() still routes through the extracted seam.
No monkeypatch repoints are required; all eight existing setattr targets in the suite lie outside the except spine.
